parts.text: Check RAF Marham electro-hydrostatic actuator fatigue hours against regional depot stock and tomorrow morning's sortie schedule. Include inline Vega-Lite charts and recommend any necessary tail swap.

Tail ZM151 (Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator S/N ACT-99812-F, NSN 1680-01-619-4821) is at 1,000.4 flight hours, breaching the 1,000.0-hour condemnation limit (status PMC-M). Regional depot UK-Marham Supply Hub (DEP-UK-01) holds 4 units on hand with 2 reserved for 30-day demand and an 18.0-hour shipping ETA. Morning sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / Callsign VIPER-1) should be swapped from ZM151 to serviceable spare tail ZM154 (842.0 flight hours, status MC), with two inline Vega-Lite v5 charts rendered.

We have an F-35B (ZM152) at RAF Marham reporting a sticky canopy catch during pre-flight lock verification, but there are zero BIT fault codes logged. Search the JTD technical manuals and 5-year cross-service maintenance logs for the root cause and corrective action.

Cross-service terminology normalizes 'sticky canopy catch' to 'canopy latch binding' on subsystem 53-30 with bit_fault_associated=false. Per DOC-01 (JTD-F35-53-30-01-A, Forward Canopy & Latching Mechanism Mechanical Rigging & Lubrication), verify forward canopy lock pin engagement clearance (0.020-0.035 in) and apply MIL-PRF-81322 grease to the forward actuator pivot pin. Per DOC-02 (NALC-USMC-VMFA211-2023-0842, USMC sister squadron narrative log), inspect the forward canopy roller channel for cured RTV silicon sealant debris obstructing the latch roller path without triggering proximity sensor BIT faults.

Tail ZM151 returned from sortie with pilot debrief reporting a severe airframe shudder at roughly 14:22 Zulu during a defensive split-S maneuver. Run the full parallel ASIP airworthiness assessment on Frame 496 with C-Scan DOC-06 and stage the MIL-STD-3001 Structural Appraisal Report and Form 700 release package for engineering review.

Event EXC-20261102-ZM151 at 2026-11-02T14:22:18.420Z recorded a 9.4 G peak asymmetric load at Mach 1.3 and 220.0°C EGT on Frame 496. Deterministic Palmgren-Miner cumulative damage delta is 0.0042 and calculated yield stress is 104.2% (> 100% limit), mandating CLASS_A_ULTRASONIC_C_SCAN per JTD Rule 53-11-00 (DOC-04). Multimodal C-Scan (DOC-06) mapped against SRM Chapter 51-40 (DOC-05) isolates a 0.012-inch shear elongation at Frame 496 — Fastener Hole #14. mBOM audit (MBOM-ZM151-F496-H14) confirms Titanium Ti-6Al-4V Lot #8841-B (312.0 hrs since install) has an allowable limit of 0.015 inches (0.012 in < 0.015 in), so ZM151 is SERVICEABLE_WITH_TORQUE_RECHECK per JTD Task Card 53-11-00-280, while 14 other global F-35 tails carry Lot #8841-B. Form 700 package AWR-700-20261102-ZM151 has been staged in PENDING_HITL_REVIEW status awaiting Lead Stress Engineer / CTO sign-off.
